kpis.description_fr: CA Google Search + autres requêtes (Lens, Shopping). Joyau de la couronne Alphabet, ~57% du CA Google Services.
kpis.description_en: Google Search + other queries revenue (Lens, Shopping). Alphabet crown jewel, ~57% of Google Services revenue.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus publicitaires YouTube (hors abonnements Premium/Music). Shorts en croissance forte, monétisation s'améliore.
kpis.description_en: YouTube ad revenue (ex-Premium/Music subs). Shorts strong growth, monetization improving.

kpis.description_fr: GCP + Workspace. Hypercroissance soutenue, infrastructure GenAI (Gemini, Vertex AI). Profitable depuis 2023.
kpis.description_en: GCP + Workspace. Sustained hypergrowth, GenAI infrastructure (Gemini, Vertex AI). Profitable since 2023.

kpis.description_fr: AdSense, AdMob, Ad Manager (publicité tierce). Segment en décélération, pression cookie-less.
kpis.description_en: AdSense, AdMob, Ad Manager (third-party ads). Decelerating segment, cookie-less pressure.

kpis.description_fr: YouTube Premium/Music/TV, Google One, Pixel devices, Play Store. Diversification non-ad.
kpis.description_en: YouTube Premium/Music/TV, Google One, Pixel devices, Play Store. Non-ad diversification.

kpis_story.description_fr: Famille Gemini (Ultra, Pro, Flash, Nano) déployée 2024-2025. Intégration Search (AI Overviews), Workspace, Android, Pixel. Réponse à OpenAI/Anthropic.
kpis_story.description_en: Gemini family (Ultra, Pro, Flash, Nano) deployed 2024-2025. Integrated into Search (AI Overviews), Workspace, Android, Pixel. Response to OpenAI/Anthropic.

kpis_story.description_fr: Waymo One robotaxi (Phoenix, SF, LA, Austin). 200k+ rides/semaine fin 2024, expansion progressive. Other Bets monétisable.
kpis_story.description_en: Waymo One robotaxi (Phoenix, SF, LA, Austin). 200k+ rides/week late 2024, gradual expansion. Other Bets monetizing.

_notes: GOOG (sans droit vote) = GOOGL (avec droit vote). Mêmes KPIs sous-jacents Alphabet.
